prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1288; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle was backing out of a space when it contacted the rear quarter panel of the claimant's parked vehicle. Insured reports no injuries at the scene. Claimant reported neck and back discomfort by phone and was advised to seek medical evaluation. Claimant is not represented by an attorney at this time.

Entry 2: Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant. Claimant describes stiffness in the neck and lower back that began within hours of the impact and has worsened with sleep. Claimant has not yet been seen by a physician and says an appointment is scheduled. Photos of both vehicles received and added to the file. Property damage estimate requested from the body shop.

Entry 3: Claimant provided medical documentation from an urgent care visit. Diagnosis listed as cervical and lumbar strain with recommended rest, over-the-counter pain management, and a follow-up with the primary care provider. Records reviewed and noted in the file. No imaging was performed at the urgent care visit.

Entry 4: Spoke with the claimant regarding the next steps. Explained the injury claim process and the documentation needed, including the primary care records and any physical therapy referrals. Claimant indicated they are still able to work with some limitations. Reminded claimant that they may consult an attorney if they choose, and that this is their decision.

Entry 5: Received the repair estimate for the claimant's vehicle and the insured's liability position is under review. Injury file remains open pending the primary care follow-up and treatment plan. Next diary set to check on medical progress and confirm receipt of all records. No settlement discussions have taken place.
